business.name: Wicker Park Bakehouse
business.goal: Fill the morning counter on weekdays

version_a.text: Fresh out of the oven: our slow-fermented sourdough, hand-shaped every morning from local grain. Wicker Park Bakehouse, open at 7.

version_b.text: Free coffee with any pastry before 9am, all week. Wicker Park Bakehouse, your neighbourhood stop.

events.text: Dovetail Bakery, two blocks away, just opened and is giving away a free croissant to the first 100 customers today
